incidents.name: Visor Finance RewardsHypervisor unvalidated depositor
incidents.notes: RewardsHypervisor.deposit() took the caller-supplied `from` contract at face value, reading IVisor(from).owner() as authorization and calling IVisor(from).delegatedTransferERC20() for payment, so an attacker contract that returned itself as owner and no-opped the transfer minted vVISR shares without depositing any VISR.

sources.ref: onchain review: RewardsHypervisor 0xc9f27a50 created 2021-09-02 by 0x79a5e766e84076d00af6d05ebfcca9a274e47815, not by attack sender 0x8efab89b; no EIP-1967 upgrade events before the incident
